experiment: qd1n Pangaea bounded Defense Post DP1

causal_basis.finding: Odin received 46 legal Defense Post actions under at least ten-percent incoming pressure and selected none. Ron and Auri used accepted Defense Posts in winning episodes.

candidate.name: Pangaea bounded Defense Post DP1
candidate.isolated_delta: On exact Pangaea with one or more incoming attacks, two-to-twenty-percent territory, troop ratio at most 0.95, and eight decisions since the previous DP1 marker, select one legal Defense Post before the ordinary defensive-build path.

fixed_seed_complementary_mirror.finding: The bounded fixture did not reach the mechanism.

unseeded_isolated_pair.finding: The sole hold was explainable terminal exhaustion. This supplied local reach and exploratory advantage, not a matched deterministic promotion result.

exploratory_delta.caution: The arms were separate stochastic four-episode requests. Territory and hold deltas diagnose the mechanism but do not establish exact matched advantage.

promotion_gates.mechanism_reach: passed: eight accepted replay-visible DP1 builds
promotion_gates.accepted_actions: failed strict gate: zero rejections but 97 holds
promotion_gates.matched_advantage: not established: fixed mirror was dormant and hosted requests were independent stochastic samples

postmortem.finding: DP1 can preserve large Pangaea positions, but preservation did not convert into a declared win. Two candidate episodes led the score table at the turn cap without a declared winner.

conversion_signal.finding: Repeated reciprocal-partner alliance requests consumed late-game decisions while the policy held a leading territorial position. The current cooldown is per partner, so several partner requests can interleave and bypass a global social cadence.

failure_tail.finding: The shield did not prevent one late action-exhaustion loop.

verdict.reason: The mechanism was reachable and improved exploratory survival, but qd1n:v91 won zero of four hosted episodes and failed the strict zero-hold gate.

next_hypothesis: Test one isolated global coalition-retry cadence that preserves reciprocal K1Z protection but prevents interleaved handshake loops whenever a reliable tactical action exists. Replay evidence must show those saved decisions converting into land or a declared win before DP1 is recomposed.
